title: A Traveling Storyteller
description: A storyteller in the market murmurs tales of distant sects and offers to teach a short parable.

choices.narrative: The parable resonates with your Dao study.

title: Herbalist's Bargain
description: A shy herbalist offers a strange tonic at a discount.

title: Crossroads Brawl
description: Two drunks start a brawl, and a purse falls from a fleeing thief.

title: Moonlit Meditation
description: Under a full moon, your meditation is unusually deep.

title: Abandoned Shrine
description: A ruined shrine contains a faded mural and a sealed offering.

title: Skeletal Bandit
description: A pale bandit steps out of a shadow, eyes empty as a bone.

title: A Lost Child
description: A crying child asks for help finding a parent.

title: Ancient Scroll Found
description: You unroll a brittle scroll describing a forgotten technique.

title: Merchant's Riddle
description: A merchant challenges you with a riddle; solve it for a reward.

title: A River Hermit
description: A hermit by the river offers a small training exercise for free.

title: Faded Letter
description: A letter with a faded seal speaks of a debt owed long ago.

title: Astral Glimmer
description: A sudden glimmer in the sky hints at an approaching omen.
